text: 据玉渊谭天，欧委会贸易和经济安全委员即将访华。 2026年诺贝尔化学奖揭晓：两位科学家破解生命手性之谜，成果深刻影响制药产业。 据央视，伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队司令顾问称将封锁霍尔木兹海峡“非法航道”。 恒生科技指数诞生6年编纂规则首次大规模调整：取消行业要求，成分股数量由30只扩至50只。 暂不救市，欧央行：解决财政困境非我职责，法国需自救。 近四年来首次加息！印度央行上调基准利率至5.5%，立场转为“有序收紧”。 AMD首席执行官：将继续探索与三星电子的代工合作，在供应紧张下正致力于优化内存。 股价承压之际，英特尔确认推进马斯克“Terafab”芯片计划。
text_en: According to Yuyuantantian, the European Commission's Trade and Economic Security Commissioner is about to visit China. The 2026 Nobel Prize in Chemistry was announced: two scientists solved the mystery of life's chirality, with results profoundly impacting the pharmaceutical industry. According to CCTV, an advisor to the commander of Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps said it will block the "illegal channel" of the Strait of Hormuz. The Hang Seng Tech Index, six years after its inception, undergoes its first major overhaul of compilation rules: industry requirements removed, constituent count expanded from 30 to 50. No rescue for now, ECB: solving fiscal dilemmas is not our job, France needs to save itself. First rate hike in nearly four years! India's central bank raises benchmark rate to 5.5%, shifting stance to "calibrated tightening." AMD CEO: Will continue to explore foundry cooperation with Samsung Electronics, working to optimize memory amid tight supply. As its stock price comes under pressure, Intel confirms it is advancing Musk's "Terafab" chip plan.
